The integer API caches item icons by itemId, itemQuantity and size; its loader creates a 36x32 AsyncBufferedImage, resolves the item sprite through the exact game sprite helper and completes the image asynchronously.

The String API caches named sprite assets by directory and requested size, loads the source Image from rs/l/F, preserves intrinsic dimensions when size=-1 and asynchronously paints it into AsyncBufferedImage.
